description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans RuntimeTypeNameFormatter, which handles formatting and parsing of .NET type names for serialization and type resolution within Orleans. It tests recoverability of formatted type names, correctness of parsed names, and error handling for invalid names.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameFormatterTests
classes.description: Unit tests verifying the correctness of RuntimeTypeNameFormatter and RuntimeTypeNameParser for diverse .NET types within Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: Inner<T>
classes.description: Nested class used within test cases to generate complex type names for testing formatting and parsing.

methods.name: FormattedTypeNamesAreRecoverable
methods.description: Verifies that formatted type names can be resolved back to original types using Type.GetType.

methods.name: ParsedTypeNamesAreIndistinguishableFromFormatted
methods.description: Ensures that parsing formatted type names yields names identical to the original formatted names.

methods.name: InvalidNamesThrowDescriptiveErrorMessage
methods.description: Checks that invalid type names produce meaningful error messages with positional info.
